page.overview:
Who is Cane?

Cane is a member of the in Tales of the TMNT. She takes her orders from and .

After escapes from Mechazoid 02, he climbs up out of the river and coughs up a small turtle. He then hears a young woman ask if the turtle just coughed up another turtle and when Raph looks up, he sees a pair of young humans staring at him. Raph stands up and starts to threaten them, but then passes out. The young woman, Cane, and the other member of the gang, Boomerang Dragon, drag Raph over to their truck.

It isn't until Mikey heads to the counter with his food that he realizes that , the big guy who helped him get a can down from a high shelf, along with Angel and Cane, are robbing the store. Cane takes up a stance behind him, holding a hockey stick to which she's attached a knife, the object Mikey misidentified as a cane. A fight eventually breaks out, with Cane attacking Mikey with her weapon, using it both as a club and as a spear.

Soon, the store begins to shake and then the floor splits open. Water floods in, bringing with it an unseen creature. Mikey urges everyone to get up on the shelves, because the doorway is blocked, but Cane decides she's getting out of there. She shoves the college girl down as she heads to the door and doesn't notice a fin in the water behind her. Cane is suddenly pulled under the surface, but comes up a few times as she's yanked back and forth. She goes under again and vanishes, and everyone reacts with shock. However, Cane fights her way back to the surface and admits her idea to leave didn't work. Angel urges her to get on the shelves, calling her an idiot.
